skill_name: Create a metric to evaluate the performance of a Movie Recommender System.
workflow: A metric can be created to evaluate the performance of a Movie Recommender System based on the user's satisfaction scores and accuracy. The user's satisfaction scores can be collected in the form of surveys or ratings given to the specific movie suggested. The accuracy can be measured by comparing the number of users who actually watched the movie and the number of users who didn't. This metric will help in determining how effective the recommender system is. Another useful metric is the predict
